name: What affects the cost of installing drywall in a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of installing drywall in a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen drywall installation varies based on several factors. Key determinants include the kitchen's square footage, the type of drywall selected (e.g., moisture-resistant, fire-rated), and the complexity of the layout (e.g., numerous corners, archways, or cutouts for cabinets and appliances). Labor rates, which can differ across the Bay Area, also play a significant role. Additional costs may arise from old drywall removal, necessary repairs to underlying structures, and the desired level of finish (e.g., smooth vs. textured).
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include kitchen size, drywall type, layout complexity, labor rates, and whether old drywall needs removal.
